cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
it's not guaranteed that an `EffectControlPoint` will be at the same point in time as the `TimingControlPoint`. Also, this is quite inefficient.

You can use `beatmap.ControlPointInfo.EffectPointAt` to avoid these two issues:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/31a447fda0532fcf15f8c8251ca890c533386492/osu.Game/Beatmaps/ControlPoints/ControlPointInfo.cs#L58
